speaker: Howard
text: There's the house. I found America's top models. Look on the roof. Hanaiis and Giselle are sunbathing. European style.

speaker: Leonard
text: Are you sure? You can recognize people on Google Earth?

speaker: Howard
text: Of course not. I got a buddy of mine at NORAD to have a spy drone fly over.

speaker: Leonard
text: NORAD? You're using military aircraft?

speaker: Howard
text: It was already targeted to poke around a nuclear reactor in Siberia. I took it an hour out of its way, tops.

speaker: Leonard
text: Sheldon? I just dropped him off at the comic book store, what?

speaker: Penny
text: Okay, where is he? Here, try and go online. No, just try.

speaker: Leonard
text: Problem with the Wi-Fi?

speaker: Howard
text: Greetings, hamburger toucher. You are probably wondering why you cannot I am with your little friends about how much you heart various things.

speaker: Howard
text: Well, this recorded message is alerting you that I am putting an end to your parasitic piggybacking upon our Wi-Fi. If you want to remedy the situation, you can contact the phone company, set up your own Wi-Fi and pay for it, or you may apologize to me.

speaker: Penny
text: Well?

speaker: Leonard
text: I reiterate, knuckle under.

speaker: Penny
text: No, no, no, no, no, it is on. I am going to introduce your friend to a world of hurt.

speaker: Leonard
text: Oh, Penny, you don't want to get into it with Sheldon. The guy's one lab accident away from being a super villain.

speaker: Penny
text: I don't care. I was in junior rodeo. I can hogtie and castrate him in 60 seconds.

speaker: Howard
text: No need to neuter the nerd. I can get you back online.

speaker: Leonard
text: There, see? Problem solved.

speaker: Howard
text: Voila. Hello, puny insects. As a consequence of your efforts to circumvent my will, everyone is awarded one additional strike.

speaker: Leonard
text: Thanks a lot, Howard.

speaker: Howard
text: What are you complaining about? I'm the one who has to take the class.
